comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Development and Internal Mobility Programs
comparisons.peer_summary: Resources provided include skill-building and leadership training, with Bank of America Academy delivering approximately 7.6 million hours of training in 2024 and over 12,000 employees finding new internal roles; 11 Employee Networks with over 320,000 voluntary memberships support professional growth.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America provide extensive voluntary training programs focused on professional development and leadership skills. JPMorgan specifically highlights resources covering artificial intelligence, data literacy, and leadership management, while Bank of America emphasizes skill-building, leadership training, and internal mobility through its Academy, delivering millions of hours of training. Both disclosures explicitly note the voluntary nature of employee networks and participation in these development opportunities.

sentences.text: In addition, the Firm offers extensive voluntary training programs and educational resources to all employees covering a broad variety of topics such as leadership and management, artificial intelligence, data literacy and operational and professional skills.

We provide a variety of resources to help employees grow in their current roles and build new skills, including resources to help employees find new opportunities, re-skill and seek leadership positions.
They are open to all employees and participation is voluntary.

In 2024, more than 12,000 employees found new roles within the Corporation, and we delivered approximately 7.6 million hours of training and development to our teammates through Bank of America Academy.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm provides ongoing educational offerings, orientation programs for new hires emphasizing culture, and annual training events to instill its culture and accelerate integration, with senior employees receiving specific leadership guidance.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase both utilize ongoing educational offerings and training to develop employees and instill firm culture. While JPMorgan focuses its voluntary training on specific technical and leadership topics like AI and data literacy, Goldman Sachs emphasizes orientation programs for new hires to accelerate cultural integration and provides specific leadership guidance for senior employees, with nearly all employees participating in annual training events.

sentences.text: In addition, the Firm offers extensive voluntary training programs and educational resources to all employees covering a broad variety of topics such as leadership and management, artificial intelligence, data literacy and operational and professional skills.
Instilling our culture in all employees is a continuous process, in which training plays an important part.
We offer our employees the opportunity to participate in ongoing educational offerings and periodic seminars facilitated by our Learning & Engagement team.

To accelerate their integration into the firm and our culture, new hires have the opportunity to receive training as soon as they start working via orientation programs that emphasize culture and networking, and nearly all employees participate in at least one training event each year.
For our more senior employees, we provide guidance and training on how to manage people and projects effectively, exhibit strong leadership and exemplify our culture.

comparisons.peer_topic: Talent development programs and leadership initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: The company offers talent development programs and leadership initiatives designed to provide employees with resources to achieve career goals, build management skills, and lead organizations, believing that such support contributes to long-term retention.
comparisons.comparison: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Chase both offer structured talent development and leadership programs aimed at career growth and management skills. JPMorgan's voluntary training covers leadership, AI, and data literacy, whereas Morgan Stanley provides leadership programs and talent development initiatives designed to help employees build management skills and lead organizations, linking these efforts to long-term retention.

sentences.text: In addition, the Firm offers extensive voluntary training programs and educational resources to all employees covering a broad variety of topics such as leadership and management, artificial intelligence, data literacy and operational and professional skills.
We are committed to the development of our workforce and supporting mobility and career growth.
Our talent development programs are designed to provide employees with the resources to help them achieve their career goals, build management skills and lead their organizations.
